name: Sample funder review areas (invented)
description: An invented set of review areas for trying the compliance review workspace. It does not reproduce any funder's or program's review guide: load your funder's own areas in the same format.

areas.title: Financial management
areas.description: How funds are budgeted, accounted for, drawn down and reconciled.
questions: Are award funds recorded separately in the accounting system, by award?
Are drawdowns supported by costs actually incurred, and reconciled each period?
Was the most recent independent financial audit completed on time, and were its findings closed?

areas.title: Technical capacity
areas.description: Whether the organization can manage its funded projects to scope, schedule and budget.
questions: Is each funded project tracked against its approved scope, schedule and budget?
Are progress reports submitted on time and consistent with project records?

areas.title: Procurement
areas.description: Purchasing with award funds: competition, documentation and required contract clauses.
questions: Are written procurement procedures in place and followed?
Does each procurement file record the method chosen, the competition and the price analysis?
Do funded contracts carry the clauses the funder requires?

areas.title: Asset management
areas.description: Records, use and disposal of equipment and facilities bought with award funds.
questions: Is there an inventory of funded equipment with its funding source and share?
Is funded equipment used for its intended purpose, and is disposal approved before it happens?

areas.title: Maintenance
areas.description: Keeping funded vehicles, equipment and facilities in good working order.
questions: Is there a written maintenance plan for funded vehicles, equipment and facilities?
Are preventive maintenance inspections done on time?

areas.title: Safety
areas.description: The safety program that covers funded operations.
questions: Is there an approved safety plan that is reviewed each year?
Are safety events investigated and corrective actions tracked to closure?

areas.title: Accessibility
areas.description: Access to services and facilities for riders with disabilities.
questions: Are accessibility features on vehicles and at stations kept working, and failures repaired promptly?
Are complaints about accessibility recorded and answered?

areas.title: Public participation
areas.description: Involving the public in service and fare changes and in funded projects.
questions: Is there a written public participation process for service and fare changes?
Are comments received recorded and considered before decisions are made?

areas.title: Equal opportunity
areas.description: Fair treatment of employees, applicants and riders.
questions: Is there a written equal opportunity policy, communicated to staff?
Are complaints of unfair treatment recorded, investigated and answered?

areas.title: Small business participation
areas.description: Opportunities for small businesses in funded contracting.
questions: Are small business participation goals set and reported where the funder asks for them?
Are payments to subcontractors monitored?

areas.title: Records and reporting
areas.description: Keeping the records the funder may ask for, and reporting on time.
questions: Are award records kept for the period the award requires, and can they be found quickly?
Were all reports due in the review period submitted on time?

areas.title: Insurance and risk financing
areas.description: Insurance cover for funded vehicles, equipment and facilities.
questions: Is funded property insured as the award requires, with current certificates on file?
